title: RB05 Biometric Profile Attestation v0.1 — semantic mdoc projection
description: Non-production validation mirror of the complete issuance/full-credential RB05 ISO mdoc namespace values. It is not a selectively disclosed DeviceResponse schema and does not validate ISO/IEC 18013-5 cryptography or CBOR structures.

docType.description: Reserved test-only document type. It must be replaced after APTITUDE governance allocates the production value.

family_name.description: Family name derived only from the authenticated source field using the exact RB05-D22-approved mapping and Unicode-normalisation rule. Exact ISO/IEC 23220-2 upper constraint is pending RB05-D10/D11; do not silently truncate, transliterate or make a lossy change.

given_name.description: Given name(s) derived only from the authenticated source field using the exact RB05-D22-approved mapping and Unicode-normalisation rule. Exact ISO/IEC 23220-2 upper constraint is pending RB05-D10/D11; do not silently truncate, transliterate or make a lossy change.

document_number.description: Unique, never-reassigned issuer-scoped RB05 serial; never a passport, PID, PhotoID, DTC, booking or loyalty identifier. Exact ISO/IEC 23220-2 upper constraint is pending RB05-D10.

issue_date.description: Administrative issue date. The mdoc field name is issue_date, not issuance_date.

expiry_date.description: Administrative expiry date, subject to the RB05 maximum-lifetime rule.

issuing_authority_unicode.description: Legal name of the RB05 issuing authority. Exact ISO/IEC 23220-2 upper constraint is pending RB05-D10.

payload.description: Canonical padded Base64 projection of 1–16,384 protected-template bytes. JSON Schema checks syntax/size; additional semantic validation is required to enforce zero pad bits. Examples are synthetic only.
